exposure: monitoring in a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Children diagnosed with reactive attachment disorder (cases) and age- and sex-matched controls were identified from Finnish national registers.
finding: The study found increased odds of reactive attachment disorder associated with low birthweight (<2500g), preterm birth (<32 weeks), induced labor, and NICU admission, while higher birthweight (4000-4499g) was associated with decreased odds.
mod_finding: Induced labor was associated with an increased odds of reactive attachment disorder.
